sents.zh: 左侧的图展示了左图主题，而右侧的图列出了右图主题。

sents.en: The chart above provides information about 题目相关词 from 年份1 to 年份2.

days.tag: 第二段·过渡句+连接词(方案骨架起点)

sents.en: Three key reasons, from my perspective, account for this phenomenon(按题换:tendency/issue).
sents.zh: 在我看来，三个关键原因可以解释这一现象。
sents.meta: 备选过渡句:A variety of reasons can be cited to account for this phenomenon. / A combination of factors has contributed to the tendency reflected in this chart.(图表专用,点题加分) / Several factors contribute to this phenomenon.。英语二写2~3点原因。

sents.en: From my perspective, the causes of 主题词(按题换) can be summarized as three main aspects.
sents.zh: 在我看来，主题词的成因可以归结为三个主要方面。

sents.en: To begin with, ... What's more, ... Last but not least, ...
sents.zh: 首先……；更重要的是……；最后但同样重要的是……。
sents.meta: 原因123连接词骨架,任记一组:For one thing, ... For another, ...(两点原因用) / Firstly, ... Secondly, ... Thirdly / First and foremost, ... Furthermore, ... Last but not least, ...

days.tag: 第二段·方案一 举例论证·个人路线

sents.zh: 例如，我的室友凯文热衷于参加劳动实践课，这帮助他培养了实践技能和合作精神。
sents.en: For instance, my roommate, Kevin, is passionate about 主题相关行为, which helps him cultivate 带来的好处.
sents.meta: 主语可换 my grandfather / my hometown(一个宜居城市);好处从六大方面挑:cultivate practical skills / keep him well informed / improve his sleep quality。

sents.zh: 在此期间，(主语)有了另一个积极结果。
sents.en: During this period, 主语+换角度的积极结果(句)。
sents.meta: 结果示例:he earns the respect of our entire class / his parents have noticed his growing curiosity / citizen satisfaction has improved。

days.tag: 第二段·方案三 从句+六大方面

sents.zh: 此外，越来越多的人开始认识到，题目相关词在某方面起着至关重要的作用。
sents.en: Furthermore, a rising number of individuals are coming to the realization that 题目相关词 plays a crucial role in 某方面.
sents.meta: 六大方面速查:personal growth 个人成长 / quality of life 生活质量 / physical and mental health 身心健康 / social progress 社会进步 / effective communication 有效沟通 / technological innovation 科技创新

sents.zh: 毫无疑问，题目相关词与某方面有着密不可分的联系。
sents.en: There is no doubt that 题目相关词 is inextricably linked to 某方面.
sents.meta: 注意谓语单复数:outdoor activities play / the popularity of X plays。

days.tag: 第二段·方案五 虚拟语气恐吓法

sents.zh: 最后，如果我们忽视题目相关词的重要性，我们将永远无法成为更好的自己。
sents.en: In the end, if we ignored the importance of 题目相关词, we would never become a better version of ourselves.
sents.meta: 个人层面,建议放原因三作段尾警醒。

sents.zh: 如果每个人都没能做某事，我们的社会将面临一个黯淡无望、一无所获的未来。
sents.en: If everyone failed to do sth., our society would be confronted with an unpromising and fruitless future.
sents.meta: 社会层面;国家层面版:If we underestimated the importance of 题目相关词, our nation would permanently lag behind in the new era of rapid development.

days.tag: 第二段·方案四倒装+方案六对比(备选·七选五任选)

sents.en: Not only does 主题词(动名词/事物,按题换) improve 某方面, but it also enables them to 另一方面.
sents.zh: 主题词不仅改善某方面，还使他们能够(另一方面)。
sents.meta: 主语复数用do:Not only do outdoor activities improve..., but they also cultivate...。improve 可换 increase/promote/boost/cultivate;enable 可换 help/allow/encourage/relieve。

sents.en: Compared with 对比对象(没有对比就创造对比), 主题词 can 小方面, so as to 大方面.
sents.zh: 与对比对象相比，主题词能够(小方面)，从而(大方面)。
sents.meta: so as to 可换 thereby promoting... / which makes it easier for sb. to...;大方面从批12词组库挑。

sents.en: In contrast to 对比对象, the advantage of 主题词 lies in 某方面.
sents.zh: 与对比对象相比，主题词的优势在于(某方面)。
sents.meta: 七选五:方案一/三/五(批7/8/9)必须,方案四/六/七任选二;主力没背熟先不碰本批。

days.tag: 第二段·方案七 比喻句(备选·画龙点睛)

sents.en: 主题词(按题换) is the engine that propels personal growth and social progress.
sents.zh: 主题词是推动个人成长与社会进步的引擎。
sents.meta: 适配:意志品质/行动实践类→engine;品德修养→foundation;思维认知→compass;心态→lighthouse;人际合作→bridge。可加插入语拉长:..., needless to say, ...。写不出来别硬套。

sents.en: 主题词(按题换) is the bridge between A and B.
sents.zh: 主题词是连接A与B之间的桥梁。
sents.meta: 例:Outdoor activities are the bridge between children and the natural world. / Parks and public spaces are the bridge between urban residents and a healthy lifestyle.

days.tag: 第三段·总结全文(方案一从句)

sents.zh: 不难得出结论，我们个人和整个社会都必须对题目相关词给予足够的重视。
sents.en: It is not difficult to draw the conclusion that enough attention must be paid to 题目相关词 by ourselves and our community.
sents.meta: 句首可加 All in all / To sum up / In general / Generally speaking / On the whole。

sents.zh: 我们应当牢记，题目相关词对我们的个人发展/社会进步至关重要。
sents.en: We should bear in mind that 题目相关词 is of great importance to our personal development / social progress.

days.tag: 第三段·否定倒装+万能应急

sents.en: By no means should we give up our efforts to 某事(按题换).
sents.zh: 我们决不能放弃在做某事上的努力。

sents.en: There is no denying that further attention must be paid to the scene/phenomenon/situation/tendency mentioned above.
sents.zh: 不可否认，对上述场景/现象/趋势必须给予进一步的关注。
sents.meta: 万能且无需修改任何内容,应急使用;另一句:Given the above analysis, it is not difficult to understand why this phenomenon has aroused widespread concern.

sents.zh: 一方面，当局必须制定严格法规来(确保主题动作)。
sents.en: For one thing, it is imperative for the authorities to formulate strict regulations to 具体动作.
sents.meta: 政府动作库:make strict laws 制定法律 / allocate more funds 拨付资金 / improve public facilities 完善公共设施 / launch public initiatives 发起公共倡议

sents.zh: 另一方面，我们应该不遗余力地做(具体动作1)，新媒体平台也应呼吁公众去(具体动作2)。
sents.en: For another, we should spare no pains to 具体动作1, and new media platforms should appeal to the public to 具体动作2.
sents.meta: 个人/媒体动作:raise public awareness of... 增强公众意识 / develop a habit of... 养成习惯 / care for the elderly 关爱老人

sents.zh: 只有通过政府、企业和公众的共同努力，我们才能有效促进主题词的健康发展。

sents.meta: 倒装句(Only开头主谓倒装);主体按题换:parents and schools / the whole society。

sents.zh: 通过这种方式，希望我们能拥抱一个更光明、更有希望的未来。
sents.en: In this way, hopefully, we may embrace a brighter and more promising future.
sents.meta: 万能收尾,不用改任何词。

sents.en: Taking into account all the factors discussed above, we may reasonably conclude that, with the passage of time and the advancement of society, the number of people who 做某事(按题换) will continue to increase in the coming years.
